scope_note: AW-III.W4 is a 3-agent parallel wave: W4.a (IR-side state_visit_frequency mining), W4.b (codegen-side emit_specialised_walker pass), W4.c (driver-side hot/cold split + helper exposure + bench checkpoint + samply attribution). This sidecar captures the W4.c-only state — the driver split has landed but the W4.b emitter integration that would produce per-grammar dta_run_<grammar> functions has NOT yet landed in this worktree. The numbers below therefore measure the cold-path-only state: parse() routes through dta_run_cold (the renamed dispatch loop) which still consults dispatch_one's 14-arm enum match per state visit. The W4 hard-gate JSON twitter ≥ 1800 MB/s number is the post-merge target, requiring W4.a + W4.b + W4.c all cherry-picked + bootstrap regen. The orchestrator runs the final hard-gate bench at wave close, NOT this sub-agent. This sidecar serves three functions: (a) baseline cold-path numbers showing dispatch_one's contribution before specialisation lands, (b) verification that the rename + helper exposure does NOT regress parse correctness or throughput vs the pre-rename HEAD, (c) samply attribution confirming dispatch_one is still 33% self-time pre-W4.b — the floor the hot/cold split is designed to remove.

samply_attribution_sidecar.method: samply record --save-only --unstable-presymbolicate -- json_monolithic --bench twitter; release+debuginfo build; cwd=crates/core
samply_attribution_sidecar.interpretation: The pre-W4.b cold-path attribution matches the AW-III research artefacts (R1 §3 cycle attribution, R3 §1 dispatch surface audit): dispatch_one floors at ~33% self-time. The W4 architectural transposition removes this floor by lowering each DtaState variant to inlined Rust labels in a per-grammar dta_run_<grammar>; the 14-arm enum match disappears at the OUTPUT (the table still carries it for replay). The post-merge expectation: dispatch_one drops to 0% in the hot path; dta_run_<grammar> appears as the new top symbol with the inlined logic distributed across its body; advance_or_pop_with stays flat unless its callers inline it; regex scanner self-time climbs proportionally as dispatch_one's vacated cycles re-distribute. Helper functions (emit_leaf, reserve_compound, close_compound) become invisible because of #[inline(always)].

regression_rationales.css_l4_normalize_and_bootstrap: Both regress vs post-AW because post-AW's bootstrap 1436 MB/s number was a correctness-regression-disguised-as-throughput-win (its own honesty_note in docs/benchmarks/post-AW.json admits it: 'parses a small subset of bootstrap.css rapidly — emits 9 records vs the golden's 92228'). AW-III.W2 closed Cluster 2 (shared EOF) which restored correct full-document parsing for css_normalize and css_bootstrap; the resulting throughput drop reflects the now-correct workload, not a true regression. The genuine baseline against which W4 measures progress is dispatch_one's 33% self-time floor — visible in the samply attribution sidecar — which the W4.b walker specialisation pass removes.
regression_rationales.rename_only_at_w4c: Every entry tagged 'rename_only' confirms that the W4.c rename + helper visibility change does not itself move throughput. The bench delta vs the W3-close baseline is ≤ 1 MB/s for all 16 non-cluster-2-affected entries — within run noise. This is the architecturally expected result: W4.c builds the API surface the W4.b emitter consumes; throughput change comes when W4.b lands and parse() bypasses the cold path.

honesty_note: This sidecar measures the W4.c rename in isolation — NOT the post-merge W4 architectural lever. The hard gate JSON twitter ≥ 1800 MB/s requires W4.a + W4.b + W4.c all cherry-picked and bootstrap regen complete. The orchestrator runs that final bench at wave close per AW-III.md §Wave schedule. This W4.c-alone sidecar exists per the operational protocol's 'samply sidecar mandated on self-time gates' rule + 'bench checkpoint per architectural lever' rule, demonstrating: (1) the rename + visibility change is throughput-neutral (no regression hides in the API mechanics), (2) the dispatch_one floor is a real ~33% self-time signal (justifying the W4 architectural transposition), (3) the post-merge expected delta is large — recovering the AW-II → post-AW 24× regression on JSON twitter and CSS bootstrap that the AW-III plan opened the tranche to address.
